status: Official release asset URLs verified live using GitHub expanded_assets HTML or official ScummVM download page. No binaries downloaded/executed by researcher. Install folder names needing archive inspection are explicitly marked; root archive verification should settle all exact names.
notes: GitHub unauthenticated API was rate limited; GitHub HTML and raw public READMEs worked using normal network escalation.
Generic ms0 versus ef0 path mapping belongs to root setup guide: ms0 is Memory Stick, ef0 is Go internal storage. Individual app support must not be inferred.
Recommended artwork: prefer embedded ICON0.PNG extracted from verified PBP so artwork matches selected build; supplied URLs are source screenshots or official PSPDEV catalogue originals.
